title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
abstract: arXiv:2610.28624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. translated_title: 工业ReMEmbR：将时空记忆扩展至机器人车队
translated_abstract: 仓库机器人车队持续不断地观察运营状况，但将这些观察保存为可复用的语义记忆会产生巨大的计算、通信和存储成本。例如，要解释某条通道反复被堵塞的原因，可能需要查看多个机器人在多个班次中的视频。我们提出了IndustrialRemembr，这是一个共享时空记忆系统，它将NVIDIA ReMEmbR扩展到机器人车队，并通过仅按需生成场景描述来降低服务器端计算量。在每个机器人上，NVIDIA Jetson使用Cosmos-Embed1将视频片段编码为检索嵌入向量，使用Cosmos3-Edge编码为视觉令牌，并使用Wan2.2 VAE编码为重建潜变量，而无需上传原始相机帧。这些编码模型还被复用于检测图像块中的人物并将其置零，以支持符合GDPR合规部署要求的个人身份信息（PII）抽象化处理。我们在视觉-语言边界处对Cosmos3-Edge进行拆分，将视觉编码部分……
tldr: 该论文提出了IndustrialRemembr共享时空记忆系统，将NVIDIA ReMEmbR从单一机器人扩展到机器人车队，通过在机器人端本地编码视频（检索嵌入、视觉令牌与重建潜变量）并仅按需生成场景描述，同时抹除个人身份信息以符合GDPR，从而大幅降低服务器端的计算、通信与存储成本。
